results.title: Google's parent company, Alphabet, is being added to the Dow Jones stock index
results.snippet: Effective next week, Google’s parent company, Alphabet, is being added to the Dow Jones stock index. Starting on June 29, Alphabet ($GOOGL) will replace Verizon ($VZ) as a part of the Dow Jones Industrial Average stock index.
